title: Game News Round-Up
summary: Daily curated games-industry news digest for 23 September 2026.

items.title: **Xbox** officially announces more layoffs and widespread changes to its entire studio structure
bullets: Microsoft is cutting 268 roles across Halo Studios, other Xbox first-party studios and central Xbox management, saying its restructuring is now roughly three-quarters complete.
Activision will take oversight of Rare and World’s Edge, and a new Activision team will develop the next Halo game.

bullets.text: A smaller Halo Studios team will remain to support existing Halo titles and the community.

bullets: Bethesda will take oversight of Obsidian, which will continue its existing projects and is also working with Bethesda Game Studios on a new Fallout project.
King will take over Microsoft Casual Games.
Playground Games and Turn 10 will be combined into a single studio responsible for the Forza and Fable franchises.
Microsoft says two potential deals for Ninja Theory fell through and it is now consulting staff on a proposed closure, while discussions around Arkane are expected to continue through the end of 2026

items.title: Sega wanted to cancel the entire **Sonic** series but the first movie saved it, says Sonic Team head Iizuka
**Escape From Tarkov** dev wants to bet on 'risky' games with its new publishing arm "Battlestate Games"
bullets: Battlestate Games Publishing aims to provide publishing support to 'hardcore' games
